topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: You'd think a man living in a two-bit apartment like the rest of us would be just another face in the crowd. But there's this guy, seen him in the lobby, wearing the same old coat, nodding hello like he doesn't have a care in the world. Turns out, he's loaded. Smashed my preconceptions to pieces. Walking around like a regular Joe when he's got more dough than the bakeries uptown. Folks are buzzing about it, asking how long he's been keeping it under wraps. Me? I'm just thinking about what secrets the other faces in this building are hiding. Money can buy a lot of things, but it can't buy everyone keeping their mouth shut.
